verdict.rationale: The official Vue site links a first-party "Migration from Vue 2" guide, which is exactly an official upgrade path to a newer major version. A community comment also praises how the Vue 3 redesign kept existing users happy. missing for 10: any detail on the guide's contents (breaking-change list, migration build or codemods, step-by-step process), coverage of minor-version upgrades, and independent hands-on reports of actually following the guide.
